thread:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding new tenant (acct 987654321012). They need ~10 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west-2 dedicated. Current VPC/NAT setup is hitting public IP exhaustion when we try to scale NAT gateways for worker subnets. Asking for quota increases and subnet adjustments.

kevin: Account ID + estimated concurrent nodes? Also which instance family exactly (p4d/p4de/etc)? AWS quota requests differ.

maria: acct 987654321012, target concurrent nodes 12 (buffer for canary + autoscale -> peak 15). We'll use p4d.24xlarge for now.

anya: Quick notes — NAT design: one NAT GW with shared EIPs will run out fast. Recommend 1 NAT GW per AZ with an EIP pool, or use NAT instances behind an autoscaler while quota approved. Also consider VPC endpoints for S3/ECR to cut egress and reduce NAT traffic.

sam: For subnet sizing, current worker subnet was a /28 (came from template). That's too small — each GPU node needs several ENIs and IPs. Propose /22 per AZ (x3 AZs) to give headroom. Example terraform snippet:

```hcl
resource "aws_subnet" "gpu_workers_az1" {
  vpc_id     = var.vpc_id
  cidr_block = "10.40.0.0/22"
  availability_zone = "us-west-2a"
  tags = { Name = "gpu-workers-usw2a" }
}
```

maria: Quotas we need to request from AWS Support:
- Elastic IPs (EIP) limit -> increase from 5 to 50 in us-west-2
- Network interfaces (ENIs) per region/account -> raise to 1000 (or increase per-instance ENI quota)
- On-demand p4d instance quota -> increase to 20 instances
- NAT Gateway Elastic IP allocation limit if separate

infra-bot: Automated checks: current EIP allocated=5, EIP in use=5, recommended EIP target=30. VPC has 2 /24s free; requested /22 OK if we reclaim one /24. No overlapping CIDR detected.

kevin: Also request EC2 spot/fleet quotas? If they want cost savings via spot we need spot instance limits increased too. Cost note: NAT GW + EIP charges scale quickly — estimate $0.045/hr per NAT + $0.005 per GB egress + EIP allocation costs.

cloud-ops: I'll open the AWS support case. Need: account 987654321012, desired EIP quota 50, ENI quota 1000, p4d on-demand 20, smooth justification (production onboarding for ML model inference). Any attachments (network diagram / projected usage)?

maria: Attached short justification in the ticket: "Customer onboarding: Dedicated inference fleet for production; peak 15 p4d nodes; batching + KV cache requires stable low-latency; NAT/GW EIP increase required to ensure cross-account S3/ECR access and TGW attachments." Adding the terraform subnet snippet and ami/instance counts.

anya: Also add request to enable VPC endpoints (interface) for SSM, EC2 messages, ECR API; that'll reduce NAT and EIP consumption. If support stalls, fallback plan: use private NAT bastion + managed egress VPC per tenant (more ops complexity).

sam: One more: ask limits team to pre-approve additional TGW attachments and route table entries — we will attach tenant VPC to central TGW for centralized egress and PrivateLink access.

cloud-ops: Case opened: AWS case # 1234567890. I've cc'd infra and product. ETA: initial response 24-48h. I'll update thread.

maria: Thanks. Also flagging finance: forecasted monthly NAT + EIP cost ~ $2.5k at scale — will include in onboarding chargeback. :money_with_wings:

kevin: Ping me if support asks for traffic diagrams or security justification.

infra-bot: Reminder: please update the onboarding checklist item "subnet-size-for-gpu" and tag the ticket in the onboard doc.

maria: Will do. Closing here for now — will post updates from AWS case. :white_check_mark:
